english_draft: Broadcom published its FY2026 Q3 financial results on September 2, 2026. The quarter ended on August 2, 2026. Revenue was about USD 29.6 billion. Revenue grew 86 percent year over year. GAAP operating income was USD 16.0 billion. Non-GAAP operating income was USD 20.1 billion. The CEO reported AI semiconductor revenue of USD 16.7 billion. AI semiconductor revenue grew 221 percent year over year. Operating cash flow was USD 14.2 billion. Capital expenditure was USD 0.5 billion. Free cash flow was USD 13.7 billion. There is no same-period preview. A later historical reconstruction is not a forecast review. For FY2026 Q4, the company guided revenue to about USD 34.8 billion. It expects AI semiconductor revenue of USD 21.7 billion. This is a forecast, not actual results. AI semiconductor revenue was about 56 percent of total revenue. The release does not provide segment operating income. Next quarter focus: deliver the AI guidance, show non-AI growth, and sustain profit and cash conversion.
reader_questions: 官方稿只给出 CEO 口径的 AI 半导体收入 167 亿美元，没有分产品（定制 AI 芯片、网络芯片等）拆分；如果后续拆分显示增长过度集中于单一客户或产品，AI 收入的可持续性判断是否会改变？
GAAP 与非 GAAP 营业利润相差约 41 亿美元，但给定事实未列出具体调整项；若这些调整项中有大额非现金项，Q4 指引对应的利润率能否直接与 GAAP/非 GAAP 口径类比？
公司 Q4 指引营收 348 亿美元显著高于 Q3 实际 296 亿美元，其中 AI 半导体预期 217 亿美元；如果该指引包含尚未确认的订单或客户需求时间表，市场会不会高估下季度实际可实现收入？
fact_checks: 日期与季度：官方发布日 2026-09-02，季度截止日 2026-08-02；本稿统一用 FY2026 Q3，未写成自然季截止 9 月 30 日。
币种与单位：全部为美元；营收约 296 亿、GAAP 营业利润 160 亿、非 GAAP 营业利润 201 亿、OCF 142 亿、capex 5 亿、FCF 137 亿；单位一致。
GAAP/非 GAAP：差异为约 41 亿美元（20.1B − 16.0B = 4.1B）；本稿未猜测具体调整项目。
集团/分部：296 亿为集团营收；167 亿为 CEO 口径的 AI 半导体收入；本稿未将其写成完整分部营业利润。
指引与共识：无同期 Preview、无可靠市场共识；Q4 营收 348 亿与 AI 半导体 217 亿按公司预测标注，未当作实际。
算术复核：AI 半导体占总营收约 56%（16.7/29.6）；FCF=OCF−capex（14.2−0.5=13.7）；均已复核。
